title: Wolfoo 2048
name: Wolfoo 2048
description: Join Wolfoo and Lucy in Wolfoo 2048 — a fun drop-and-merge number puzzle for the whole family! Drop numbered tiles into a 5-column board. Plan each drop, build big chains, and beat your high score in this relaxing endless mode. Need a hand?
